items.q: How much do garage cleanout services cost in Caledon?

items.q: Can several structures be handled in one garage cleanout visit?

items.q: Can tools or materials from the garage be saved rather than thrown out?
a: Often, yes — say so at the walkthrough. Anything still worth keeping gets set aside rather than swept into general disposal.

items.q: Do you work carefully around an active farm property?
